chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Mansur ibn Yunus, from Abdul Hameed ibn Awwaz, who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), 'I marry the woman; is it correct for me to have sexual relations with her, and I have not yet paid her anything from her dower?' He (peace be upon him) said, 'Yes. It is merely a debt upon you.'

key_terms.أُوَاقِعَهَا: to have sexual relations with her

ai.seo_question: Can a husband have sexual relations with his wife before paying her full dowry?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes that the payment of the dower (mahr) is not a prerequisite for the validity of consummation, distinguishing between the right of the wife to receive payment and the legal capacity of the marriage contract itself. In Shia jurisprudence, the unpaid mahr is treated as a debt (dayn) against the husband, meaning the wife retains her right to claim it later without the marriage being considered invalid or incomplete. This ruling underscores the flexibility in marital relations while ensuring the wife's financial security is preserved as a binding obligation.
